rv.q: For anyone who knows Jessica Martin from her lead roles in Me and My Girl and Mack and Mabel, her turn as a matronly Mormon mummy in GRINDR MOM may prove an alliteration too far. I went along to Waterloo East's new one-woman monologue to find out what it's all about. Jessica Martin in Grindr Mom at Theatre.
Grindr Mom deserves to be far more than a casual hook-up; it’s the kind of show worth coming back to again and again.
